rate_limit_observed.note: OpenRouter free-tier accounts without purchased credits are capped at 50 free model requests per day across all :free models. Quota was exhausted during the v2 stratified run after 5 completed real-model trials (plus the 3-trial v1 smoke run and initial model availability probes).

provenance.statement: Written for this benchmark in this repository; not copied from public benchmarks, MARS datasets or training lineages. Registered as held-out split mars-edit-heldout-v1.

preregistered_bar.statement: MARS's default edit format for that model beats omp-stock on host-verified solve rate for small models with p < 0.05 on the paired exact sign test over tasks, and its cost per verified solve is not worse (USD when either arm is priced, else total tokens).

secondary.label: secondary (exploratory, not adjusted for multiple comparisons)

verdict.summary: Exploratory: the suite has 1 task(s), below the power-analysis minimum of 129, so the pre-registered verdict is not computed (mars:hashline vs omp-stock: 0 vs 0 discordant tasks, p = 1.00).

limitations: Every arm ran the same 1 task(s), 1 repeat(s), model nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl:free, forwarded seed per (task, repeat) and per-task budget.

omp-stock runs Oh My Pi's own built-in tools (read, edit, write, grep) with its default, model-resolved edit mode in a throwaway copy; MARS arms use only mars_* tools. Neither arm may run commands, and process-wide fetch is disabled during trials except the injected model transport.
Verification is host-side: the throwaway workspace must equal the expected tree byte for byte.
Paired analysis counts a task as solved when a strict majority of its repeats solved.

Only the confirmatory arm (mars:hashline, the model's static default format) decides the pre-registered bar; other MARS-vs-omp-stock comparisons are secondary (exploratory, not adjusted for multiple comparisons) and shown with Holm-adjusted p-values.
Seeds are forwarded to OpenAI-compatible endpoints; providers apply them best effort.
